title: Czechia: Czech Inflation Creeps Up as Prague Clashes With Brussels Over Carbon Costs · 16 Oct
keywords: Czechia, inflation, Czech National Bank, interest rates, cost of living, EU climate policy, emissions trading, ETS, Andrej Babiš, Central Europe, carbon pricing, monetary policy, EU, industrial competitiveness, household finances
notes: Czechia faces a twin economic pressure test as inflation returned above target in September 2026 and Prime Minister Andrej Babiš escalated his confrontation with EU climate policy. The two developments are reshaping household finances, industrial competitiveness, and the country's relationship with the European Union. Together they present the government with difficult choices between short-term relief and longer-term structural adjustment.
